_note: DOS CGA Phantasie I art (tools/scripts/extract_dos_map_tiles.py -> tiles/, extract_dos_town_picture.py -> ui/town.png), CGA palette 1 high intensity. Expected layout under root: tiles/tiles.json, tiles/overworld/fog.png + pat-NN-NAME.png, tiles/dungeon/glyph-XX-NAME.png, ui/town.png (rows 0..8 and 191..199 blank: the game draws the menu bar and town name); optional (s157, extract_dos_defeat_pictures.py): ui/defeat-temple.png, ui/defeat-demon.png, ui/defeat-ghost.png, ui/defeat-figures/NN.png (the party-defeat screens, CGA palette 0 high as OV1 sets it). Never the default (auto_select false): only an explicit choice selects it. DOS shows no monster/portrait/title art here, so those names resolve to nothing in this pack (no borrowing from Amiga). Overworld: per-cell patterns chosen by the map_tiles rule (asset-manifest.json), not whole-region pictures.
name: DOS (CGA)

defeat_pictures._note: s157 static (endgame.md section 4): I DOS's party-defeat screens, drawn on DOS's 5.00-s line clock (dos-screens.json defeat) whichever layout is on (the Amiga's sequence needs amiga.json defeat_screen and its door, not here). OV1 0x2af sets CGA palette 0 (COM 0x3abd(0)); '`core.defeat.your_party_has_been_defeated`' on black; then defeat.temple (CEMEN.IBM with the doorway blanked in buffer A, OV1 0x2fd..0x378: no wipe on screen) and a ghost per member with '`core.defeat.arrived_at_astral_plane`'; defeat.demon (CEMEN.IBM as stored, the face) and the ghosts again with '`core.defeat.great_demon_speaks`'; per member its fate before its line: defeat.figure.<race> (PRT1IBM.PAT, OV1 0x787; UNDEAD race 15) or its slot cleared (OV1 0x747). Row: OV1 0x5fe clears text rows 19..23, ghosts at y 156, gap (320 - 32n)/(n+1) rounded down to 4. Line: OV1 0x24c centres it on text row 24 (yellow, pen 3). palette: the screen shows CGA palette 0 high while these screens are up (the pack's palette 1 elsewhere).
